title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: SAP Service Disruption Management (SDM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP Service Disruption Management (SDM) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What you'll do:

We are looking for an experienced SAP technology professional within our organization, responsible for and managing the resolution of major incidents and crises that impact our services and systems. This individual will ensure that incidents are managed efficiently and effectively, minimizing the impact on service delivery and ensuring the highest level of customer satisfaction. The role requires strong SAP technical and process expertise, exceptional problem-solving skills, working on governance model with partners, and the ability to work under pressure.

The Service Disruption Management (SDM) team responsibilities include:

• Working in incident and crisis management team, ensuring timely and effective response to major incidents and crises. Coordinate with various teams to resolve incidents and restore normal service operations as quickly as possible

• Act as the primary point of contact for incident escalation during shift. Ensure that all escalations are handled promptly and appropriately and performing on-duty responsibilities outside of working hours when necessary

• Oversee thorough root cause analysis for all critical incidents. Develop and implement preventive measures to avoid recurrence

• Maintain clear and effective communication with stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle. Provide regular updates on incident status, impact, and resolution efforts

• Identify and drive initiatives to improve incident management processes. Standardize and simplify incident response procedures to enhance efficiency and effectiveness

• Define, track, and achieve key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) related to incident/outages and crisis management

• Lead, mentor, and develop the incident management team. Foster a collaborative and high-performance culture within the team

• Ensure that the incident management team is well-trained and equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge to handle incidents effectively

• Work closely with partners and internal teams, to ensure a coordinated and integrated approach

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of incident management processes, incident reports, and lessons learned. Share knowledge and best practices with the broader organization


What you bring:

• 10+ years of Technical Operations in ABAP/JAVA/HANA/DB2/Performance analysis role

• Hands-on experience in one of the areas like Basis, System Performance Management, Lifecycle events (Upgrades / Updates), SAP Project Management, Support, Escalation Management. Knowledge of products like SAP Cloud-Connector, S4 would be an added advantage

• Practical knowledge with SAP technologies like SAP NetWeaver, Business Objects, SAP HANA and SAP Sybase Adaptive Server Enterprise (ASE)

• Experience with Managed/Hosting services or SAP Private Cloud or Public Cloud Operations/Support

• Application Security, Backup and recovery strategies, performance tuning, System Copies, export-import, high availability, and disaster recovery strategy, export-import

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in one of the following areas: Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management

• Professional Certification of SAP BASIS, Business Object with exposure to Project Management tasks including PMP and ITIL certification

• Cloud knowledge (e.g., experience of working in Public Cloud Domains like Microsoft Azure, AWS and GCP)

• Capacity to continuously acquire new knowledge in an independent and proactive way

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication and networking skills

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship

• Strong customer service focus

• Very good English language skill

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Applied Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Applied Scientist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Senior Applied Scientist - Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits; candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months, with possibility of extension

Hours: 40 hours per week


About the Role

The Inbound team develops highly scalable solutions to determine item attribute values (such as color, material, and style) and verify merchandise authenticity. The Senior Applied Scientist will own the development and deployment of machine learning solutions while influencing the technical direction of the team.

This role works closely with Tech Leads, Product, and Engineering partners to design and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Computer Vision and Machine Learning, along with a strong focus on building robust production-ready systems and mentoring team members.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards.
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and support informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key system components and solutions to ensure business needs are met.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to develop data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor team members and help establish domain expertise across the team.
  • Contribute to the company’s intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and applied Machine Learning.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or 8+ years of equivalent industry experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in large-scale production environments.
  • Deep understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning algorithms and techniques, including CNNs, transformers, GANs, optimizers, and regularization, as well as experiment design and best practices such as A/B testing, training and serving pipelines, and feature engineering.
  • Extensive experience with scientific Python libraries such as NumPy and pandas, and Machine Learning frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and Scikit-Learn.
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with experiment automation frameworks such as Ray Tune, Weights & Biases (W&B), and Kubeflow.
  • Experience with cloud technologies including AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python.


Preferred Requirements

  • PhD preferred in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • Background applying Machine Learning techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused mindset with a passion for delivering high-quality models.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems

title: AI Benchmark Software Engineer - 75243
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Software Engineer - 75243 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for experienced Software Engineers to design and build high-quality multi-agent benchmark tasks based on real-world software engineering workflows.

In this role, you will create tasks grounded in real open-source code changes such as bug fixes, migrations, and refactors. These tasks are used to evaluate how effectively AI agents can understand large codebases, apply precise modifications, and produce correct, testable outputs.

You will work within a structured evaluation framework (Harbor), define clear task instructions, design verification logic, and decompose complex engineering problems across multiple specialized agents.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks based on real-world open-source code changes (bug fixes, migrations, refactors)
  • Work with the Harbor evaluation framework to run and validate tasks inside Docker environments
  • Write clear, precise task instructions specifying file paths, function signatures, expected behavior, and constraints
  • Design and implement Python-based verification scripts to validate correctness of agent-generated code changes
  • Create decomposition strategies that split complex code changes across multiple independent sub-agents
  • Run, debug, and refine tasks within containerized environments to ensure reproducibility and determinism
  • Evaluate task performance signals and improve task quality, clarity, and difficulty


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Python and JavaScript development
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench)
  • Strong experience reading and navigating large open-source codebases (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI, Node.js, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Git workflows , including pull requests, diffs, cherry-picking, and working with specific commits
  • Comfortable working with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging container issues)
  • Experience writing test scripts (pytest, unittest, or custom assertion-based testing)
  • Ability to write clear, precise, and unambiguous technical specifications


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading foundation model companies
  • Collaborate on high-impact work at the frontier of LLM evaluation and reasoning
  • Remote, flexible opportunities with global teams


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week).



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior SDR / BDR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior SDR / BDR em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Representante de Desenvolvimento de Negócios | Vaga Comercial Remota | Mercado Educacional Brasileiro


Quem Somos


A Liza é uma startup de EdTech que usa Inteligência Artificial para ajudar professores a economizar tempo e melhorar a gestão pedagógica. Nossa plataforma ajuda professores a planejar aulas, avaliar atividades, criar exercícios, organizar informações dos alunos e trabalhar de forma mais eficiente em suas rotinas escolares diárias.

Nossa equipe atua entre os Estados Unidos e o Brasil, combinando execução no estilo do Vale do Silício com profundo conhecimento do sistema educacional brasileiro.


Our Leadership


  • Lisa Zhang, Fundadora: fundadora internacional baseada no Vale do Silício
  • Fernando Cofiel, COO: ex-COO da Maple Bear por 9 anos, com experiência em operações escolares, escala e franquias
  • Rogério Luiz, CTO: PhD em Ciência da Computação com foco em Inteligência Artificial
Sobre a Vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) SDR / BDR para apoiar o crescimento da Liza no mercado educacional brasileiro. Esta é uma vaga comercial remota , com foco em prospecção consultiva, qualificação de oportunidades, agendamento de reuniões com decisores estratégicos e apresentação do produto para potenciais clientes.


Esta vaga é ideal para alguém com experiência em vendas B2B, SaaS, CRM e desenvolvimento de negócios, que se sinta confortável conduzindo abordagens por telefone, e-mail, WhatsApp e LinkedIn. Buscamos uma pessoa organizada, proativa, orientada a metas e capaz de gerenciar um pipeline comercial estruturado em um ambiente de startup acelerado.

Responsabilidades
  • Prospectar escolas, redes de ensino, secretarias de educação e parceiros estratégicos no Brasil
  • Identificar e qualificar leads inbound e outbound
  • Conduzir abordagens consultivas por telefone, e-mail, WhatsApp e LinkedIn
  • Agendar reuniões com Secretários(as) de Educação, líderes escolares, coordenadores pedagógicos e outros decisores
  • Realizar apresentações do produto para potenciais clientes e explicar como a Liza pode apoiar suas necessidades
  • Mapear as necessidades dos potenciais clientes e identificar oportunidades comerciais
  • Gerenciar follow-ups e avançar oportunidades pelo funil de vendas
  • Manter o CRM atualizado com todas as interações, próximos passos e status do pipeline
  • Apoiar conversas iniciais de parcerias e vendas
  • Ajudar a adaptar mensagens comerciais e estratégias de abordagem para o mercado educacional brasileiro
  • Trabalhar com a liderança para melhorar os processos de prospecção, qualificação e conversão
  • Representar a empresa de forma profissional em interações com educadores, gestores públicos e parceiros institucionais
Requisitos
  • Graduação completa
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em vendas, pré-vendas, SDR, BDR, desenvolvimento de negócios ou áreas comerciais
  • Experiência com prospecção ativa e qualificação de leads
  • Experiência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em SaaS, tecnologia ou educação
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de CRM de vendas, como Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similares
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal em português
  • Capacidade de conduzir conversas consultivas com diferentes perfis de decisores
  • Capacidade de apresentar um produto de forma clara e profissional para potenciais clientes
  • Forte organização para gerenciar pipeline, follow-ups e múltiplos contatos ao mesmo tempo
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente, orientado a metas e confortável com uma rotina comercial remota
  • Conforto para trabalhar em um ambiente de startup em rápido crescimento
Diferenciais
  • Experiência no mercado educacional brasileiro
  • Experiência com setor público ou secretarias de educação
  • Conhecimento sobre processos de compras públicas
  • Experiência prévia em empresas SaaS
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas e qualificação estratégica de oportunidades
  • Experiência com apresentações de produto, diagnóstico comercial ou passagem de bastão para Account Executives / Customer Success
Perfil Que Buscamos

Buscamos alguém que faça mais do que apenas enviar mensagens. Esta pessoa deve saber construir relacionamentos, entender o contexto do cliente, qualificar oportunidades reais e apresentar o produto de forma conectada às necessidades do potencial cliente.

A pessoa ideal é disciplinada no uso do CRM, forte em follow-up, confortável em lidar com objeções e capaz de transformar listas de contatos em reuniões qualificadas e oportunidades comerciais.

O Que Oferecemos
  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Vaga comercial em tempo integral
  • Alto nível de autonomia
  • Impacto direto no crescimento da empresa
  • Oportunidade de crescimento para posições comerciais mais estratégicas
  • Ambiente rápido, empreendedor e com impacto direto no setor educacional
Remuneração

Salário base de R$5.000 a R$10.000 por mês , conforme experiência, mais comissão .

A remuneração variável poderá ser baseada em reuniões qualificadas, oportunidades geradas, apresentações de produto realizadas, conversão de leads e avanço no pipeline comercial.

Confira esta oportunidade para DataOps Engineer (Relocation to Portugal) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation. Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 2/3 years of experience as a DataOps Engineer;
  • Hands-on experience creating, automating, and maintaining data pipelines;
  • Experience working with DevOps practices and cloud environments;
  • English level B2 or higher;
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!


If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .


The future is waiting for you — and so are we!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract; Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Especialista em Contabilidade de Carbono e Certificações - Pesquisa
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em Contabilidade de Carbono e Certificações - Pesquisa em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

OBJETIVO

Integrar a equipe técnica do Instituto E+ com foco em contabilidade de carbono e certificações, atuando de forma transversal nas agendas de descarbonização industrial e bioeconomia. Este cargo combina atuação técnica e institucional, incluindo interlocução com poder público, setor produtivo e demais stakeholders na temática de mercado de carbono e instrumentos correlatos.


PERFIL SOLICITADO

Buscamos uma pessoa com sólida base técnica em contabilidade de GEE, metodologias internacionais e sistemas de certificação, com capacidade de análise regulatória e atuação instituciona l. Valorizamos perfil estruturado, propositivo, com autonomia técnica e habilidade para dialogar com diferentes públicos e representar o Instituto em espaços estratégicos.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver e defender abordagens metodológicas de contabilidade de GEE alinhadas às especificidades brasileiras
  • Atuar na interlocução técnica com instituições públicas, representantes setoriais e demais stakeholders
  • Acompanhar e analisar leis, normativas e regulamentações relacionadas à contabilidade de carbono, certificações e mercado de carbono
  • Contribuir para o posicionamento técnico do Instituto sobre instrumentos como o Sistema Brasileiro de Comércio de Emissões (SBCE) e mecanismos internacionais, como CBAM e outros mecanismos de ajuste de carbono na fronteira.
  • Identificar oportunidades de geração de valor para a neoindustrialização brasileira por meio do aprimoramento de metodologias, instrumentos de mercado e sistemas de certificação
  • Garantir consistência técnica e metodológica em relatórios, notas técnicas, apresentações e posicionamentos institucionais
  • Representar o Instituto E+ em eventos, grupos de trabalho e projetos nacionais e internacionais na temática


REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS


Formação superior completa em Engenharia Agronômica, Agronomia, Engenharia Ambiental, Ciências Ambientais, Ciências Florestais ou áreas correlatas


Conhecimento sólido das seguintes metodologias e referenciais:

  • IPCC
  • ISO 14040 e ISO 14044 (Avaliação de Ciclo de Vida)
  • GHG Protocol
  • Metodologias setoriais como WorldSteel, IAI e Bonsucro


Conhecimento de mercado de carbono e instrumentos regulatórios e comerciais, tais como:

  • Sistema Brasileiro de Comércio de Emissões (SBCE)
  • CBAM (União Europeia)
  • EU ETS
  • EU RED
  • RenovaBio
  • Entendimento da regulação de carbono no mercado doméstico e internacional


Capacidade analítica e de síntese

Excelente redação técnica

Inglês avançado


DIFERENCIAIS


  • Experiência prévia com certificações ambientais, verificação e auditoria
  • Experiência em descarbonização industrial e bioeconomia
  • Experiência em interação institucional com governo e setor produtivo
  • Vivência em consultorias, think tanks, associações setoriais ou organismos internacionais
  • Capacidade de articular análise técnica detalhada com visão estratégica
  • Boa comunicação oral e segurança para representação institucional
  • Perfil colaborativo e flexível para atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / Angular / Azure) | Remote (Brazil) | $R20,000 per month


We're working exclusively with a fast-scaling, internationally established B2B SaaS business to find a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants to do more than just ship code; someone who wants to help shape a platform.


The Platform

This isn't a greenfield start-up with no traction, nor a legacy enterprise stuck in technical debt. It's something rarer: a mature, mission-critical SaaS platform mid-way through a significant cloud-native rebuild, with real customers, real revenue, and a serious engineering team that knows what it's doing.


The platform powers high-value, high-volume transactional operations globally; think live, real-time environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product. £50m+ transacted in 2026 alone. Clients operate across multiple sectors and international markets.


The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and product leadership to extend and evolve the next-generation platform across:

  • Full-stack development; .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core on the backend, Angular / TypeScript on the front
  • Real-time application development using SignalR
  • Cloud-native architecture on Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, Monitor)
  • CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices
  • Multi-tenant white-label SaaS architecture
  • Engineering standards, mentoring, and long-term technical direction


This is a hands-on senior role with genuine influence, not a ticket-taker. You'll be contributing to architecture decisions, not just implementing them.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience
  • Strong .NET / ASP.NET Core and Angular / TypeScript skills
  • Experience building scalable APIs and distributed backend systems
  • Cloud-native development on Azure
  • Docker and containerised deployment; solid Kubernetes understanding
  • PostgreSQL or equivalent relational database experience
  • Someone who cares about operational reliability, clean code, and product outcomes, not just velocity
  • Bonus points for experience with real-time / event-driven systems, multi-tenant SaaS, high-availability environments, or AI-assisted workflows.


Why This Role

  • Fully remote, flexible working culture built on trust
  • Small, experienced, highly collaborative team, you'll work closely with founders and leadership
  • High ownership, high influence, your decisions will shape the platform
  • A genuinely interesting problem domain with technical complexity that rewards good engineering
  • Up to $R20k-$R23k pcm + 28 days holiday (inclusive of UK bank holidays)


If you're a senior engineer who wants to do the best work of your career on a platform that genuinely matters to its customers, we'd like to speak with you.

title: Personal Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Personal Assistant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Personal Assistant to CEO & COO (Remote)



Company Description

CelMedia is a fast-growing global media and education company focused on digital growth, online programs, and high-performance sales operations. Working across international markets, our team operates in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where adaptability, organization, and communication are essential.

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Personal Assistant to directly support the CEO and COO with both professional and personal day-to-day coordination.



Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Personal Assistant to the CEO & COO.

The Personal Assistant will work closely with leadership to manage schedules, coordinate meetings and travel, organize daily priorities, assist with personal and administrative tasks, and help maintain smooth communication and organization across different areas of the business and personal routines.

This role requires someone highly organized, proactive, trustworthy, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment with shifting priorities.



Responsibilities

  • Manage calendars, appointments, scheduling, and daily priorities for the CEO & COO
  • Coordinate personal and business-related tasks and logistics
  • Assist with travel arrangements, reservations, and itinerary organization
  • Organize emails, documents, spreadsheets, and internal workflows as needed
  • Follow up on tasks, deadlines, and ongoing projects
  • Help maintain communication between leadership and team members
  • Support with personal assistant tasks and day-to-day coordination needs
  • Assist with administrative and operational support as needed
  • Help keep routines, schedules, and priorities organized efficiently



Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Coordinator, or similar role
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Portuguese
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities remotely
  • High attention to detail and strong follow-through
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, calendars, spreadsheets, and communication tools
  • Strong problem-solving skills and adaptability
  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion
  • Experience supporting executives, founders, or entrepreneurs is a plus



Compensation

  • Salary range: R$4,000 – R$6,000/month
  • Fully remote position
  • Opportunity for long-term growth within the company

title: AI Benchmark Engineer (Reasoning/Math) - 75046
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Reasoning/Math) - 75046 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving
  • Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference
  • Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness

  • Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers (not subjective or open-ended)
  • Familiarity with AI coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench and Terminal-bench
  • Comfortable with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging containers)

Nice to have:

  • Experience creating math competition problems (e.g., AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar)
  • Research experience in mathematics, theoretical computer science, or quantitative fields
  • Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification
  • Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI)
  • Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Planning/Operations) - 75063 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for AI Benchmark Engineers specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:

  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables

Develop verification scripts to evaluate:

  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)

Build decomposition strategies:

  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 4 weeks (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location :

OBJETIVO

Integrar a equipe técnica do Instituto E+ com foco em contabilidade de carbono e certificações, atuando de forma transversal nas agendas de descarbonização industrial e bioeconomia. Este cargo combina atuação técnica e institucional, incluindo interlocução com poder público, setor produtivo e demais stakeholders na temática de mercado de carbono e instrumentos correlatos.

Buscamos uma pessoa com sólida base técnica em contabilidade de GEE, metodologias internacionais e sistemas de certificação, com capacidade de análise regulatória e atuação instituciona l. Formação superior completa em Engenharia Agronômica, Agronomia, Engenharia Ambiental, Ciências Ambientais, Ciências Florestais ou áreas correlatas

Capacidade analítica e de síntese

Excelente redação técnica

Inglês avançado

  • Experiência em interação institucional com governo e setor produtivo

  • Capacidade de articular análise técnica detalhada com visão estratégica
  • Boa comunicação oral e segurança para representação institucional
  • Perfil colaborativo e flexível para atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

Requisitos
  • Graduação completa
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em vendas, pré-vendas, SDR, BDR, desenvolvimento de negócios ou áreas comerciais
  • Experiência com prospecção ativa e qualificação de leads
  • Experiência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em SaaS, tecnologia ou educação
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de CRM de vendas, como Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similares
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal em português
  • Capacidade de conduzir conversas consultivas com diferentes perfis de decisores
  • Capacidade de apresentar um produto de forma clara e profissional para potenciais clientes
  • Forte organização para gerenciar pipeline, follow-ups e múltiplos contatos ao mesmo tempo
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente, orientado a metas e confortável com uma rotina comercial remota
  • Conforto para trabalhar em um ambiente de startup em rápido crescimento
Diferenciais
  • Experiência no mercado educacional brasileiro
  • Experiência com setor público ou secretarias de educação
  • Conhecimento sobre processos de compras públicas
  • Experiência prévia em empresas SaaS
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas e qualificação estratégica de oportunidades
  • Experiência com apresentações de produto, diagnóstico comercial ou passagem de bastão para Account Executives / Customer Success
Perfil Que Buscamos

Buscamos alguém que faça mais do que apenas enviar mensagens. Esta pessoa deve saber construir relacionamentos, entender o contexto do cliente, qualificar oportunidades reais e apresentar o produto de forma conectada às necessidades do potencial cliente.

A pessoa ideal é disciplinada no uso do CRM, forte em follow-up, confortável em lidar com objeções e capaz de transformar listas de contatos em reuniões qualificadas e oportunidades comerciais.

  • Vaga comercial em tempo integral

Salário base de R$5.000 a R$10.000 por mês , conforme experiência, mais comissão .

A remuneração variável poderá ser baseada em reuniões qualificadas, oportunidades geradas, apresentações de produto realizadas, conversão de leads e avanço no pipeline comercial.

title: AI Benchmark Engineer (Data Analysis) - 75113
description:

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking experienced Engineers — Data Analysis to design and develop high-quality multi-agent benchmark tasks that evaluate the analytical reasoning, coordination, and execution capabilities of advanced AI systems.

In this role, you will build realistic benchmark tasks that require AI agents to analyze large, messy, multi-source datasets, decompose work across specialist sub-agents, and arrive at specific, verifiable conclusions. These tasks may involve structured and semi-structured data such as CSVs, JSON files, logs, reports, survey results, vendor assessments, or financial and operational documents.


Your work will help measure how effectively AI systems perform complex analytical workflows involving cross-referencing, contradiction detection, anomaly identification, and statistical reasoning across multiple data sources.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Design and author multi-agent benchmark tasks centered on complex data analysis workflows
  • Create realistic synthetic datasets or curate real-world style datasets across domains such as finance, operations, security, or market analysis
  • Build tasks that require agents to perform cross-referencing, anomaly detection, contradiction identification, and statistical computation across multiple sources
  • Develop decomposition guides that split analytical work across specialist sub-agents such as financial, technical, security, or operations analysts
  • Write precise oracle logic or verification scripts that validate specific analytical conclusions rather than generic summaries
  • Create reproducible evaluation environments using Python and Docker
  • Review task performance signals to ensure strong separation between weaker and stronger agentic systems
  • Refine tasks to improve determinism, clarity, difficulty, and scoring quality


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data analysis and scripting (pandas, NumPy, or similar)
  • Experience working with real-world, messy datasets (CSV, JSON, logs, reports)
  • Ability to design non-trivial analytical questions with clear, specific, and verifiable answers
  • Solid understanding of statistical concepts (averages, distributions, outliers, correlations)
  • Familiarity with AI coding benchmark environments (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench)
  • Comfortable working with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging containers)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: AI Benchmark Software Engineer - 75243
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Software Engineer - 75243 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for experienced Software Engineers to design and build high-quality multi-agent benchmark tasks based on real-world software engineering workflows.

In this role, you will create tasks grounded in real open-source code changes such as bug fixes, migrations, and refactors. These tasks are used to evaluate how effectively AI agents can understand large codebases, apply precise modifications, and produce correct, testable outputs.

You will work within a structured evaluation framework (Harbor), define clear task instructions, design verification logic, and decompose complex engineering problems across multiple specialized agents.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks based on real-world open-source code changes (bug fixes, migrations, refactors)
  • Work with the Harbor evaluation framework to run and validate tasks inside Docker environments
  • Write clear, precise task instructions specifying file paths, function signatures, expected behavior, and constraints
  • Design and implement Python-based verification scripts to validate correctness of agent-generated code changes
  • Create decomposition strategies that split complex code changes across multiple independent sub-agents
  • Run, debug, and refine tasks within containerized environments to ensure reproducibility and determinism
  • Evaluate task performance signals and improve task quality, clarity, and difficulty


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Python and JavaScript development
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench)
  • Strong experience reading and navigating large open-source codebases (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI, Node.js, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Git workflows , including pull requests, diffs, cherry-picking, and working with specific commits
  • Comfortable working with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging container issues)

Quem Somos


A Liza é uma startup de EdTech que usa Inteligência Artificial para ajudar professores a economizar tempo e melhorar a gestão pedagógica. Nossa plataforma ajuda professores a planejar aulas, avaliar atividades, criar exercícios, organizar informações dos alunos e trabalhar de forma mais eficiente em suas rotinas escolares diárias.

Nossa equipe atua entre os Estados Unidos e o Brasil, combinando execução no estilo do Vale do Silício com profundo conhecimento do sistema educacional brasileiro.


Our Leadership

Sobre a Vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) SDR / BDR para apoiar o crescimento da Liza no mercado educacional brasileiro. Esta vaga é ideal para alguém com experiência em vendas B2B, SaaS, CRM e desenvolvimento de negócios, que se sinta confortável conduzindo abordagens por telefone, e-mail, WhatsApp e LinkedIn. Buscamos uma pessoa organizada, proativa, orientada a metas e capaz de gerenciar um pipeline comercial estruturado em um ambiente de startup acelerado.

Responsabilidades
  • Prospectar escolas, redes de ensino, secretarias de educação e parceiros estratégicos no Brasil

  • Representar a empresa de forma profissional em interações com educadores, gestores públicos e parceiros institucionais
Requisitos
  • Graduação completa
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em vendas, pré-vendas, SDR, BDR, desenvolvimento de negócios ou áreas comerciais
  • Experiência com prospecção ativa e qualificação de leads
  • Experiência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em SaaS, tecnologia ou educação
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de CRM de vendas, como Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similares
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal em português

  • Capacidade de apresentar um produto de forma clara e profissional para potenciais clientes
  • Forte organização para gerenciar pipeline, follow-ups e múltiplos contatos ao mesmo tempo
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente, orientado a metas e confortável com uma rotina comercial remota

Diferenciais
  • Experiência no mercado educacional brasileiro

Buscamos alguém que faça mais do que apenas enviar mensagens. Esta pessoa deve saber construir relacionamentos, entender o contexto do cliente, qualificar oportunidades reais e apresentar o produto de forma conectada às necessidades do potencial cliente.

A pessoa ideal é disciplinada no uso do CRM, forte em follow-up, confortável em lidar com objeções e capaz de transformar listas de contatos em reuniões qualificadas e oportunidades comerciais.

  • Trabalho 100% remoto
